name: hireloop
description: HireLoop: a job hunting and recruitment platform (MERN, TypeScript).

scripts.dev: npm run build -w @hireloop/shared && concurrently -n shared,api,web -c gray,blue,magenta "npm run dev -w @hireloop/shared" "npm run dev -w @hireloop/api" "npm run dev -w @hireloop/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @hireloop/shared && npm run build -w @hireloop/api && npm run build -w @hireloop/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @hireloop/shared && npm run typecheck -w @hireloop/api && npm run typecheck -w @hireloop/web
scripts.test: npm run build -w @hireloop/shared && npm run test -w @hireloop/api && npm run test -w @hireloop/web
